preconditions.description: The polynomial string should contain only digits, 'x', '^', and '+' characters.

preconditions.expression: all(char.isdigit() or char in 'x^+' for char in polynomial)
preconditions.description: Each character in the polynomial string should be a digit, 'x', '^', or '+'.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(exponent) for exponent in polynomial.split('x') if '^' in exponent)
preconditions.description: All exponents in the polynomial should be non-negative integers.

postconditions.description: The function should return the derivative of the polynomial evaluated at the given point x.
